1.name: Customers
1.description: Master record of all Shopify customers — people who have created accounts or placed orders. One row per customer.

fields.name: total_orders
fields.description: Lifetime count of orders placed by customer

fields.name: total_spent
fields.description: Lifetime total amount spent by customer

2.name: Products
2.description: Master product catalog in Shopify. One row per product (parent level, not variant).

fields.name: vendor
fields.description: Brand or vendor name for the product

fields.name: product_created_at
fields.description: Date product was created in Shopify

fields.name: variant_count
fields.description: Number of variants for this product

fields.name: published_at
fields.description: Date product was published (as string, may be null)

3.name: Product Variants
3.description: Individual SKU-level variants of products (size, color, etc.). One row per variant.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Variant option values combined (e.g. Blue / Large)

fields.name: cost_per_item
fields.description: Cost of goods for this variant

fields.name: requires_shipping
fields.description: Whether this variant requires physical shipping

4.name: Collections
4.description: Product collections (categories/groupings) used to organize the storefront catalog.

fields.name: rules_condition
fields.description: For smart collections: all or any rule condition

fields.name: product_count
fields.description: Number of products in this collection

5.name: Locations
5.description: Physical or virtual locations where inventory is stocked and fulfilled from (stores, warehouses, 3PLs).

fields.name: is_active
fields.description: Whether the location is currently active

fields.name: fulfills_online_orders
fields.description: Whether location can fulfill online orders

fields.name: active_inventory_count
fields.description: Total SKUs stocked at this location

6.name: Staff
6.description: Shopify staff accounts and admin users who manage the store.

fields.name: is_active
fields.description: Whether the staff account is active

fields.name: account_count
fields.description: Placeholder measure: count of staff rows (always 1)

7.name: Discount Codes
7.description: Discount codes and their rules — percentage, fixed amount, free shipping, BOGO.

fields.name: price_rule_id
fields.description: FK to the parent price rule

fields.name: code
fields.description: The discount code string customers enter

fields.name: ends_at
fields.description: Expiry date as string (may be null)

fields.name: usage_limit
fields.description: Maximum times the code can be used

fields.name: times_used
fields.description: Actual number of times code has been used

fields.name: is_active
fields.description: Whether the discount code is currently active

8.name: Shipping Zones
8.description: Shipping zones defining geographic areas and their associated shipping rates.

fields.name: countries
fields.description: Comma-separated list of country codes in this zone

fields.name: profile_id
fields.description: Shipping profile this zone belongs to

fields.name: min_order_subtotal
fields.description: Minimum order subtotal for rate eligibility

fields.name: rate_count
fields.description: Number of shipping rates configured in this zone

9.name: Sales Channels
9.description: Sales channels through which orders are placed (online store, POS, Instagram, Amazon, etc.).

fields.name: is_active
fields.description: Whether the channel is currently active

fields.name: order_count
fields.description: Total orders received through this channel

fields.name: total_revenue
fields.description: Total revenue attributed to this channel

10.name: Vendors
10.description: Suppliers and brand vendors from whom products are sourced.

fields.name: contact_email
fields.description: Primary contact email for the vendor

fields.name: active_product_count
fields.description: Number of active products sourced from this vendor

11.name: Orders
11.description: All customer orders placed through Shopify. One row per order (header level).

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: FK to customer who placed the order

fields.name: financial_status
fields.description: Payment status: pending, paid, refunded, voided

fields.name: subtotal_price
fields.description: Order subtotal before shipping and taxes

fields.name: total_discounts
fields.description: Total discounts applied to the order

fields.name: total_tax
fields.description: Total tax collected on the order

fields.name: total_price
fields.description: Grand total paid by the customer

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Currency code for the order (USD, EUR, etc.)

fields.name: discount_code
fields.description: Discount code applied to the order, if any

12.name: Order Line Items
12.description: Individual product line items within each order. One row per line item.
12.grain_description: One row per order line item

fields.name: product_title
fields.description: Product name at time of purchase

fields.name: variant_title
fields.description: Variant name at time of purchase

fields.name: unit_price
fields.description: Price per unit at time of purchase

fields.name: line_total_price
fields.description: Total line revenue (qty x unit price)

fields.name: fulfillment_status
fields.description: Fulfillment status of this specific line

fields.name: requires_shipping
fields.description: Whether this line requires physical shipping

13.name: Refunds
13.description: Refund transactions issued against orders. One row per refund event.

fields.name: refund_reason
fields.description: Reason for refund (customer request, defective, etc.)

fields.name: restock
fields.description: Whether items were restocked to inventory

fields.name: staff_id
fields.description: Staff member who processed the refund

14.name: Refund Line Items
14.description: Individual product lines included within a refund. One row per refunded line item.
14.grain_description: One row per refund line item

fields.name: line_item_id
fields.description: FK to the original order line item

fields.name: variant_id
fields.description: FK to the product variant refunded

fields.name: restock_type
fields.description: How inventory was handled: no_restock, return, cancel

15.name: Payments / Transactions
15.description: Payment gateway transactions associated with orders (charges, refunds, voids).

fields.name: transaction_type
fields.description: Type: authorization, capture, sale, refund, void

fields.name: gateway
fields.description: Payment gateway name (Shopify Payments, PayPal, etc.)

fields.name: payment_method
fields.description: Payment method: credit_card, paypal, gift_card, etc.

16.name: Fulfillments
16.description: Fulfillment shipments for orders — one fulfillment per shipment event with tracking info.

fields.name: location_id
fields.description: FK to location that fulfilled the order

fields.name: fulfillment_status
fields.description: Status: pending, open, success, cancelled, error

fields.name: items_count
fields.description: Number of line items in this fulfillment

17.name: Draft Orders
17.description: Orders created manually by staff on behalf of customers, before confirmation.

fields.name: staff_id
fields.description: Staff member who created the draft order

fields.name: converted_order_id
fields.description: FK to completed order if draft was converted

fields.name: line_items_count
fields.description: Number of line items in the draft order

18.name: Gift Cards
18.description: Gift cards issued and used in the store, tracking balance and redemption.
18.grain_description: One row per gift card issued

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: FK to customer who received/owns the gift card

fields.name: order_id
fields.description: FK to order through which gift card was purchased

fields.name: initial_value
fields.description: Original loaded value of the gift card

fields.name: balance
fields.description: Current remaining balance on the gift card

fields.name: times_used
fields.description: Number of times the gift card was redeemed

19.name: Returns (RMA)
19.description: Return Merchandise Authorization requests and their resolution lifecycle.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: FK to the customer initiating the return

fields.name: return_status
fields.description: Status: requested, approved, received, completed, rejected

fields.name: return_reason
fields.description: Reason for return: defective, wrong item, changed mind, etc.

fields.name: return_received_at
fields.description: Date items were received back (as string, may be null)

20.name: Purchase Orders
20.description: Purchase orders raised to vendors/suppliers for inventory replenishment.

fields.name: vendor_id
fields.description: FK to vendor being ordered from

fields.name: location_id
fields.description: FK to destination location for the inventory

fields.name: po_status
fields.description: Status: draft, ordered, partial, received, cancelled

fields.name: expected_arrival_date
fields.description: Expected arrival date (as string, may be null)

fields.name: total_cost
fields.description: Total cost of the purchase order

fields.name: total_units_ordered
fields.description: Total units ordered across all line items

21.name: Purchase Order Line Items
21.description: Individual SKU lines within a purchase order to a vendor.
21.grain_description: One row per purchase order line item

fields.name: variant_id
fields.description: FK to product variant being ordered

fields.name: po_created_at
fields.description: Date the purchase order was created

fields.name: line_total_cost
fields.description: Total cost for this line (qty x unit cost)

fields.name: line_status
fields.description: Line status: pending, partial, received, cancelled

22.name: Disputes / Chargebacks
22.description: Payment disputes and chargebacks raised by customers against orders.

fields.name: transaction_id
fields.description: FK to the disputed payment transaction

fields.name: dispute_reason
fields.description: Reason code: fraudulent, not_received, duplicate, etc.

fields.name: dispute_status
fields.description: Status: open, under_review, won, lost, accepted

fields.name: response_due_date
fields.description: Deadline to respond to the dispute

fields.name: evidence_submitted
fields.description: Whether evidence was submitted to counter the dispute

23.name: Inventory Levels
23.description: Current inventory quantity per variant per location. State atom tracking on-hand, committed, and available stock.
23.grain_description: One row per variant per location (latest state)

fields.name: quantity_incoming
fields.description: Units incoming from purchase orders in transit

24.name: Order Status History
24.description: Tracks the current status of every order. State atom deduped to latest known status per order.

fields.name: financial_status
fields.description: Latest payment status: pending, paid, refunded, voided

fields.name: fulfillment_status
fields.description: Latest fulfillment status: unfulfilled, partial, fulfilled

fields.name: order_status
fields.description: Overall order status: open, closed, cancelled

fields.name: status_updated_at
fields.description: Timestamp of the most recent status change

fields.name: days_open
fields.description: Days since order was placed and still open

25.name: Customer Account Status
25.description: Current loyalty tier, account health, and engagement state per customer. Deduped to latest state.
25.grain_description: One row per customer (latest account state)

fields.name: loyalty_tier
fields.description: Loyalty level: bronze, silver, gold, platinum

fields.name: marketing_opt_in
fields.description: Whether customer has opted into marketing

fields.name: status_updated_at
fields.description: Timestamp of last account status update

fields.name: days_since_last_order
fields.description: Days elapsed since customer last placed an order

fields.name: lifetime_orders
fields.description: Total number of orders the customer has placed

fields.name: lifetime_spend
fields.description: Total amount spent by the customer to date

26.name: Cart Events
26.description: Timestamped events capturing customer cart interactions: items added, removed, and abandoned.
26.grain_description: One row per cart interaction event

fields.name: variant_id
fields.description: FK to product variant involved in the event

fields.name: cart_value_at_event
fields.description: Total cart value at the moment of the event

27.name: Checkout Events
27.description: Events tracking customer progress through the checkout funnel (initiated, payment entered, completed).
27.grain_description: One row per checkout funnel event

fields.name: checkout_step
fields.description: Funnel step: initiated, contact_info, shipping, payment, completed

fields.name: cart_total
fields.description: Cart total at this checkout step

fields.name: items_count
fields.description: Number of items in the cart at this step

28.name: Page View Events
28.description: Individual storefront page views, capturing traffic sources and product view activity.
28.grain_description: One row per page view event

fields.name: page_type
fields.description: Type: home, product, collection, blog, cart, other

fields.name: product_id
fields.description: FK to product (if product page view)

fields.name: traffic_source
fields.description: Traffic source: organic, paid, email, social, direct

fields.name: view_count
fields.description: Count of views (always 1 per row, for aggregation)

29.name: Inventory Adjustments
29.description: Audit log of every inventory quantity change: sales, returns, manual adjustments, transfers.
29.grain_description: One row per inventory adjustment event

fields.name: adjustment_reason
fields.description: Reason: sale, return, recount, damage, received, transfer

fields.name: reference_id
fields.description: Linked order ID, PO ID, or other reference

fields.name: quantity_delta
fields.description: Change in quantity (positive = increase, negative = decrease)

fields.name: staff_id
fields.description: Staff member who made the adjustment (if manual)

30.name: Price Change Events
30.description: Audit log of price changes made to product variants, capturing before/after values.
30.grain_description: One row per price change event

fields.name: variant_id
fields.description: FK to product variant whose price changed

fields.name: staff_id
fields.description: Staff who made the price change

31.name: Daily Sales Summary
31.description: Daily aggregate of sales metrics — orders, revenue, refunds, and net sales by day.
31.grain_description: One row per day per sales channel

fields.name: orders_count
fields.description: Number of orders placed on this day

fields.name: avg_order_value
fields.description: Average order value for the day

32.name: Weekly Inventory Snapshot
32.description: Weekly freeze of inventory levels per variant per location for trend analysis and replenishment planning.
32.grain_description: One row per variant per location per week

fields.name: snapshot_week
fields.description: Monday date of the snapshot week

fields.name: quantity_on_hand
fields.description: Units on hand at snapshot time

fields.name: units_sold_prior_week
fields.description: Units sold in the 7 days before snapshot

33.name: Monthly Customer Cohort Snapshot
33.description: Monthly cohort performance summary — tracks retention, repeat purchase rate, and LTV by acquisition month.
33.grain_description: One row per acquisition cohort per reporting month

fields.name: cohort_month
fields.description: Month customers in this cohort first purchased

fields.name: cohort_size
fields.description: Total customers in the acquisition cohort

fields.name: active_customers
fields.description: Customers who purchased in the snapshot month

fields.name: retention_rate
fields.description: Percentage of cohort who purchased this month

fields.name: total_revenue
fields.description: Revenue from cohort in the snapshot month

fields.name: avg_order_value
fields.description: Average order value for cohort in snapshot month

fields.name: cumulative_ltv
fields.description: Average customer LTV to date for the cohort

fields.name: months_since_acquisition
fields.description: Months elapsed between cohort_month and snapshot_month

34.name: Product Performance Snapshot
34.description: Monthly product-level performance summary: sales, views, conversion, margin.
34.grain_description: One row per product per month

fields.name: snapshot_month
fields.description: First day of the reporting month

fields.name: gross_revenue
fields.description: Gross revenue for the product in the month

fields.name: refund_amount
fields.description: Refunds attributed to this product in the month

fields.name: page_views
fields.description: Number of product page views in the month

fields.name: conversion_rate
fields.description: Ratio of purchases to page views

fields.name: gross_margin_pct
fields.description: Gross margin percentage for the product

35.name: Carriers
35.description: Master dimension of freight carriers and transport service providers including trucking companies, airlines, shipping lines, and couriers.

fields.name: carrier_name
fields.description: Full legal name of the carrier

fields.name: carrier_type
fields.description: Mode of transport: Air Freight, Full Truckload, Intermodal, Less Than Truckload, Rail Freight

fields.name: service_tier
fields.description: Service level: Economy, Express, Premium, Standard

fields.name: is_active
fields.description: Whether the carrier is currently active

36.name: Warehouses
36.description: Master dimension of warehouse and distribution centre locations including owned, leased, and third-party logistics (3PL) facilities.
36.grain_description: One row per warehouse or distribution centre

fields.name: warehouse_name
fields.description: Name or code of the warehouse

fields.name: warehouse_type
fields.description: Type: Bonded, Cold Storage, Cross-Dock, Distribution, Fulfillment

fields.name: country
fields.description: Country where the warehouse is located

fields.name: city
fields.description: City where the warehouse is located

fields.name: is_active
fields.description: Whether the warehouse is currently operational

fields.name: total_capacity_sqm
fields.description: Total floor area in square metres

37.name: Routes
37.description: Master dimension of defined transport routes between origin and destination locations used for planning and rate management.
37.grain_description: One row per defined transport route

fields.name: transport_mode
fields.description: Primary transport mode: Air, Intermodal, Ocean Freight, Rail, Refrigerated Truck, Truck

fields.name: is_active
fields.description: Whether the route is currently active

fields.name: distance_km
fields.description: Total distance of the route in kilometres

fields.name: standard_transit_days
fields.description: Expected transit days for this route

38.name: Vehicles
38.description: Master dimension of transport vehicles in the fleet including trucks, vans, ships, aircraft, and rail wagons.
38.grain_description: One row per vehicle in the fleet

fields.name: vehicle_type
fields.description: Vehicle category: Box Truck, Cargo Van, Flatbed Truck, Refrigerated Truck, Semi-Truck, Sprinter Van, Tanker Truck

fields.name: fuel_type
fields.description: Fuel type: CNG, Diesel, Electric, Gasoline, Hybrid, LNG

fields.name: is_active
fields.description: Whether the vehicle is currently in service

fields.name: commissioned_date
fields.description: Date the vehicle was commissioned into service

39.name: Drivers
39.description: Master dimension of drivers and transport operators assigned to vehicle trips.
39.grain_description: One row per driver or transport operator

fields.name: license_class
fields.description: Driver licence class or certification level (Class A CDL, Class B CDL, Class C)

fields.name: is_active
fields.description: Whether the driver is currently active

fields.name: hire_date
fields.description: Date the driver was hired or onboarded

40.name: Shipments
40.description: Core shipment records representing each consignment booked for transport from an origin to a destination, including cost, weight, and status tracking.

fields.name: shipment_status
fields.description: Current status: Cancelled, Delayed, Delivered, In Transit, Processing

fields.name: freight_cost
fields.description: Total freight cost charged for the shipment

fields.name: is_hazardous
fields.description: Whether the shipment contains hazardous goods

41.name: Freight Orders
41.description: Freight order records representing contractual transport orders issued to carriers, which may span multiple shipments or legs.
41.grain_description: One row per freight order issued to a carrier

fields.name: order_status
fields.description: Status: Cancelled, Delivered, In Transit, Pending

fields.name: agreed_cost
fields.description: Agreed freight cost for this order

fields.name: actual_cost
fields.description: Actual invoiced cost for this order

fields.name: distance_km
fields.description: Total distance covered by this freight order

fields.name: order_date
fields.description: Date the freight order was issued

42.name: Cargo Items
42.description: Line-item level cargo records representing individual packages, pallets, or containers within a shipment.
42.grain_description: One row per cargo item or package within a shipment

fields.name: item_type
fields.description: Package type: Bag, Carton, Container, Crate, Drum, Pallet

fields.name: commodity_category
fields.description: Commodity category: Agriculture, Apparel, Automotive Parts, Chemicals, Consumer Goods, Cosmetics, Electronics, Food & Beverage, Furniture, Industrial Machinery, Medical Equipment, Petroleum Products, Pharmaceuticals, Raw Materials, Rubber & Plastics, Steel & Metals, Textiles

fields.name: is_hazardous
fields.description: Whether the item is classified as hazardous

fields.name: weight_kg
fields.description: Weight of the cargo item in kilograms

fields.name: volume_cbm
fields.description: Volume of the cargo item in cubic metres

fields.name: declared_value
fields.description: Declared monetary value of the cargo item

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: Number of units in this cargo item

fields.name: created_date
fields.description: Date the cargo item was recorded

43.name: Shipment Legs
43.description: Individual legs of a multi-modal or multi-stop shipment journey, each representing one segment handled by a carrier on a specific route.
43.grain_description: One row per shipment leg segment

fields.name: carrier_id
fields.description: FK to carriers — carrier for this leg

fields.name: route_id
fields.description: FK to routes — route for this leg

fields.name: vehicle_id
fields.description: FK to vehicles — vehicle used for this leg

fields.name: leg_sequence
fields.description: Sequence number of this leg within the shipment

fields.name: leg_distance_km
fields.description: Distance covered on this leg in kilometres

fields.name: leg_cost
fields.description: Freight cost attributed to this leg

fields.name: actual_transit_hours
fields.description: Actual transit duration for this leg in hours

fields.name: planned_departure_date
fields.description: Planned departure date for this leg

44.name: Delivery Events
44.description: Tracking and milestone events for shipments throughout their lifecycle, including pickups, handovers, customs clearance, and final delivery scans.
44.grain_description: One row per tracking event on a shipment

fields.name: leg_id
fields.description: FK to shipment legs — related leg (nullable)

fields.name: event_type
fields.description: Event type: Arrived, Customs Cleared, Customs Hold, Delivered, Departed, Exception - Address Error, Exception - Damaged, Exception - Missing Docs, Exception - Weather Delay, In Transit, Out for Delivery, Picked, Returned

fields.name: is_exception
fields.description: Whether this event represents an exception or delay

fields.name: delay_hours
fields.description: Hours of delay associated with this event (0 if no delay)

fields.name: event_date
fields.description: Date and time the event was recorded

45.name: Vehicle Trips
45.description: Vehicle trip event records capturing each completed or in-progress trip made by a vehicle with driver assignment, distance, and duration.

fields.name: vehicle_id
fields.description: FK to vehicles — vehicle used for this trip

fields.name: driver_id
fields.description: FK to drivers — driver assigned to this trip

fields.name: freight_order_id
fields.description: FK to freight orders — related freight order

fields.name: distance_km
fields.description: Total distance travelled on this trip

46.name: Fuel Consumption
46.description: Fuel consumption records per vehicle per trip or per refuel event, used for fleet cost analysis and carbon emissions tracking.

fields.name: trip_id

fields.name: fuel_type
fields.description: Fuel type: CNG, Diesel, HVO, LNG

fields.name: fuel_cost
fields.description: Total cost of fuel for this record

fields.name: cost_per_litre
fields.description: Unit cost per litre of fuel

fields.name: distance_km
fields.description: Distance driven associated with this fuel consumption

fields.name: record_date

47.name: Customs Declarations
47.description: Customs and border control declaration records for international shipments, tracking duties, taxes, and clearance status.

fields.name: clearance_status
fields.description: Status: Cleared, Held, Rejected, Under Review

fields.name: country_of_origin

48.name: Logistics Incidents
48.description: Incident records capturing cargo damage, loss, theft, accidents, or delivery failures during transport operations.

fields.name: incident_status
fields.description: Status: Closed, In Progress, Resolved, Under Investigation

fields.name: estimated_loss_value
fields.description: Estimated financial loss from the incident

fields.name: resolution_days
fields.description: Number of days to resolve the incident

49.name: Warehouse Inventory
49.description: Current inventory state per SKU per warehouse, showing stock on hand, reserved quantities, and available capacity at any point in time.

fields.name: storage_zone
fields.description: Storage zone: Zone-A, Zone-B, Zone-C, Zone-D, Zone-E

fields.name: quantity_on_hand

fields.name: inventory_value

51.name: Warehouse Locations
51.description: Master list of warehouse locations and storage bins. One row per warehouse location.

fields.name: zone
fields.description: Zone within the warehouse (e.g. A, B, C) (Zone-A, Zone-B, Zone-C, Zone-D)

fields.name: bin

fields.name: country

fields.name: is_active

fields.name: created_date
fields.description: Date the location was created in the system

52.name: Purchase Orders
52.description: Header-level purchase order records capturing order placement details, totals, and status. One row per purchase order.

fields.name: po_date

fields.name: expected_delivery_date

fields.name: po_status

fields.name: total_line_items
